metaDescription: Locate Hostinger's default nameservers in hPanel so you can point a domain registered elsewhere to your hosting.
intro: If you're connecting a domain bought through another registrar to your Hostinger hosting, you'll need to find and copy Hostinger's nameservers. This guide covers locating them in hPanel in about five minutes.

steps.heading: Log in to Hostinger
steps.body: Click the Login button at the top-right corner of the Hostinger website and enter your credentials.

steps.heading: Open the Websites section
steps.body: From the hPanel dashboard, click Websites to see the sites connected to your account.

steps.heading: Manage your site
steps.body: Find the site you're working on and click Manage next to it to open its settings.

steps.heading: Locate Nameservers or DNS Details
steps.body: Scroll down or use the search bar on the management page to find the Nameservers or DNS Details section.

steps.heading: Copy the nameservers
steps.body: You'll typically see Hostinger's default nameservers, such as ns1.dns-parking.com and ns2.dns-parking.com — copy these to paste into your domain registrar's settings.

faq.question: What are Hostinger's default nameservers?
faq.answer: They're typically listed as ns1.dns-parking.com and ns2.dns-parking.com, though you should always confirm the exact values shown in your account.

faq.question: Why do I need my nameservers?
faq.answer: You need them to point a domain registered with another provider, like GoDaddy or Namecheap, to your Hostinger hosting.

faq.question: Where else can I find nameserver information in Hostinger?
faq.answer: The Domain section of hPanel also displays similar DNS and nameserver details.

faq.question: What happens if I copy the nameservers incorrectly?
faq.answer: Even a small typo can cause your domain connection to fail, so copy them exactly as shown in your dashboard.
